withheld.not_in_plan: Inventory isn't in your plan for this site
withheld.no_permission: Your role doesn't show these figures

common.notFoundBody: It may not exist, or it isn't in your projects.

list.title: Projects
list.intro: Every project you work on, with its inventory as it stands now. Each figure opens the units behind it.
list.search: Search by name, code or city
list.emptyHint: Clear the filters or set up a new project.
list.newProject: Set up in this demo; units are created once unit creation lands

tabState.planned: This section arrives with Gate {{gate}}. Nothing here is shown until it is built and reviewed.
tabState.plannedDecision: This section waits for owner decision {{gate}}. Nothing here is shown until it is decided and built.
tabState.notInPlan: Your organisation's plan doesn't include this module for {{site}}.

p360.title: Project 360
p360.choose: Choose a project to open its 360 view.
p360.unitsIntro: Units of this project by tower or phase. Open the unit matrix to see every unit, or a row to filter it.
p360.leadsEmpty: No leads in this project yet.
p360.documentsEmpty: No documents are linked to this project in the demo yet. The document centre arrives with Gate E.13; documents will follow this project's permissions.
p360.activityEmpty: Nothing has happened to this project in this demo session yet. Holds, storage allocations and setup steps appear here.
p360.setupNote: This project was set up and approved in this demo session. It has no units yet: unit creation arrives with a later slice.

setup.title: Project setup
setup.intro: Prepare a new project in steps. It is saved as a draft after each step; someone other than you approves it before it becomes active.
setup.empty: No project is being set up.
setup.emptyHint: Start a new project to prepare its basics, site and structure.
setup.noAccessTitle: Project setup needs a setup role
setup.noAccess: Preparing or approving a project needs the project setup permissions. In this demo they are held by Hina Baig (projects and inventory officer) and Kashan Lodhi (projects director), both provisional until the owner decides the roles (E-06, E-07).

basics.name: Project name
basics.codeHint: 2 to 5 capital letters or digits, unique in your organisation (used in unit references).
basics.kindHint: Towers and commercial buildings have floors; plots are laid out in phases.

site.siteHint: A project attaches to one of your organisation's licensed sites.
site.entityHint: Exactly one legal entity sells and invoices for the project. It is configured by administration and cannot be changed here.
site.noSites: No site of your organisation has inventory in its plan.

structure.total: This structure plans {{count}} units. Nothing is created until unit creation lands; this is the plan the approver reviews.
structure.basicsFirst: Save the basics first: the structure depends on the kind of project.

review.title: Review
review.ready: Every step is saved. Submit the project for approval by someone else.
review.missing: Save every step before you submit.
review.returnEffect: The project goes back to {{name}} with your reason. Nothing is activated.
review.approveEffect: {{name}} becomes an active project. It has no units until unit creation lands.
review.ownRequest: You prepared this project, so someone else must approve it.
review.waiting: Waiting for approval by someone other than {{name}}.
review.notApprover: Only a projects director can approve this project.

setup.readOnly: This project is {{state}}; it can't be changed now.

matrix.title: Unit matrix
matrix.intro: Every unit of a project by tower, floor and position, or by phase. The text in each cell says its status; open a unit to see more.
matrix.noProject: There is no project whose inventory you can see.
matrix.keyboardHint: Arrow keys move between units, Home and End go to the ends of a floor, Enter opens a unit.

unit.title: Unit {{ref}}
unit.subtitle: {{project}} · {{where}}
unit.priceNote: Illustrative list price from the demo seed; pricing arrives with Gate E.3.
unit.heldSeed: Held by the demo seed: there is no hold record, no expiry and nobody can release it here.
unit.heldMine: You placed this hold; only you can release it.
unit.heldOther: Only the person who placed it can release it.
unit.notHoldable: Only available units can be held.
unit.holdLeadHint: Open leads of this project you can see.
unit.holdNoLeads: There is no open lead of this project you can see.
unit.storageNone: No storage is allocated to this unit.
unit.historyEmpty: No hold or storage change for this unit in this demo session.

availability.title: Live availability
availability.intro: Available, held, reserved and booked units right now. A hold counts only while it is in force; an expired hold is available again.
availability.holdsEmpty: No live hold is in force.
availability.lapsedIntro: These holds ran out. They no longer count as held; the record stays for history.
availability.seeded: {{held}} held, {{reserved}} reserved and {{booked}} booked units come from the demo seed (no hold, reservation or booking record).
availability.autoRefresh: Refreshes every 30 seconds and after every change.
availability.noProjects: There is no project whose inventory you can see.

storage.title: Storage
storage.intro: Storage lockers and rooms are their own records, allocated to a booked unit of the same project and released with a reason. Every change stays in the history.
storage.allocateIntro: Only booked or allocated units of {{project}} can receive storage. Bookings are the demo seed until Gate E.5.
storage.targetHint: Type part of a unit reference.
storage.noTargets: No booked unit of this project matches.
storage.releaseEffect: {{ref}} becomes available again. The allocation to {{unit}} stays in its history.
storage.manageNote: Allocating and releasing storage needs the storage permission (the provisional projects and inventory officer in this demo).
